newsitem.title: INDIA: BT to buy stake in India's Bharti Cellular.
newsitem.headline: BT to buy stake in India's Bharti Cellular.

text.p: British Telecommunications Plc said on Friday it intends to buy a 22.5 percent stake in India's Bharti Cellular Ltd (BCL).

The Bharti Cellular consortium (BCL) currently consists of India's Bharti group, Italy's STET Spa, Mauritian cellular operator Emtel, Britain's MSI and GMC, a subsidary of France's CGE group, BT said in a statement released in the Indian capital.
"Necessary applications have been made to the Indian Department of Telecommunications for BT to take over GMC, with its 22.5 pct state in BCL," the statement said.
BCL operates one of the two cellular services in the Delhi licence area comprising Delhi and nearby Faridabad, Noida, Gurgaon and Ghaziabad.
With more than 65,000 subscribers, it has the largest subscriber base of all Indian cellular operators.
